title: Keith Dunstan: home page concepts
question: Which introduction would make you want to explore Keith's writing? Choose one, combine elements, or suggest a revision.

options.label: Meet Keith
options.thesis: Introduce the person, then show the range of his writing.
options.viewport: A generous introduction and portrait, followed by an editorial guide to his subjects and publications.
options.risk: The biography must stay concise so the writing remains central.

options.label: Australian life, observed
options.thesis: Begin with familiar subjects and reveal the writer connecting them.
options.viewport: A broad typographic introduction above an asymmetric subject index and a compact portrait.
options.risk: Subject labels need compelling real reading selections.

options.label: A writer in the public eye
options.thesis: Explain Keith through the newspapers and magazines that carried his voice.
options.viewport: Portrait and introduction beside a prominent publication itinerary, followed by books.
options.risk: Publication names need context for readers who never encountered them.
